notes.title: Festive goodies await in Sweet Dreams Alex!
notes.notes:
Hey Dream Builders, feeling festive? 

'Tis the season to be jolly, and Alex is ready to spread some festive cheer! We’re thrilled to share with you our Sweet Dreams Alex Christmas update, just in time for the most wonderful time of the year…

🎁 New Christmas PJ Sets for Alex: Get into the spirit with not one, but TWO adorable Christmas-themed pajama sets for Alex! With Santa or a reindeer to choose from, we've got the perfect outfit to keep Alex cozy and Christmassy in the dreamscapes.

🎄 Deck the Halls with Toy Decor: You can now add a Christmas tree to Alex’s bedroom, the perfect addition to her dreamy world.

🦌 Reindeer Plushie: You’ll also be able to place the cutest reindeer plushie on Alex’s drawers, too. It's the perfect cuddly companion for Alex as she prepares to embark on dreamy adventures throughout the festive season.

💡 Festive Wall Decor: Finally, you can also decorate Alex’s wall with lights and snow that will make every night feel like a winter fairy tale.

We hope you love these festive updates, and thank you for being part of the Sweet Dreams Alex community! Your creativity and enthusiasm continues to inspire us as we play your custom levels, and if you’re yet to contribute or experience others’ creations yourself, join us in our Discord server.

Happy Dreaming and Merry Christmas!

notes.title: Sweet Dreams Alex is a wholesome puzzle and construction game
notes.notes:
Mixing together puzzles and room building, Sweet Dreams Alex is a rather wholesome idea for a game about keeping away nightmares and it's out now with Native Linux support.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2023/10/sweet-dreams-alex-is-a-wholesome-puzzle-and-construction-game

notes.title: Sweet Dreams Alex Comes To Mac!
notes.notes:
Dream Builders!

We are pleased to announce that Sweet Dreams Alex is now available on Mac.
Alongside this, we have a number of fixes in this update for you. The patch notes are below:

[b]Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Added mac x64 build
[*] Added frog and snake pajamas
[*] Updates to various levels
[*] Added alternative resolutions to the settings, and a proper scaling for non 16:9 screens
[*] Discord button on main screen now has visuals when reacting to hover/click
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where credits scroll speed would vary per settings / computer
[*] Fixed being able to place structures out of bounds of the level in play mode
[*] Amended typos in tutorial text and translation keys in diaries
[*] Achievements are now unlocked at game start, which fixes the issue with missing achievements for some players
[*] Pressing esc during play now pauses the game
[*] Tutorial buttons are no longer clickable behind esc menu
[*] Diaries and tablets are now always clickable in campaign, they were previously unclickable when going to next level
[/list]

[b]Quality of Life Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the indicators for resources that have variations and that have rotations
[*] Theo/diary/tablet are decorations in custom levels
[*] When toggling between solution and build mode using spacebar, game retains the previous speed
[*] You can now duplicate custom levels with a new button (replaces "explore" button)
[/list]

We want to thank our Dream Builder community for the support so far.

To join the conversation, join us in the Sweet Dreams Alex [url=https://discord.gg/HMJshR9n6H]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Sweet Dreams Alex Is Available Now!
notes.notes:
Dear fellow Dream Builders,

We are delighted to announce that Sweet Dreams Alex is available to purchase now!

[previewyoutube=U_5muiCg8Wo;full][/previewyoutube]

It’s time to get creative as you build labyrinths full of traps and distractions, designed to keep Nightmares away from Alex until the morning comes.

Take a break from the stresses of life and immerse yourself in Alex’s dreamscapes, where over 250 hand-crafted puzzles await you. Every moment is accompanied by a deep, relaxing atmospheric soundtrack by acclaimed lo-fi artists such as edelwize and Towerz, which perfectly complements the charming pixel art aesthetic.

There are six unique dream worlds to explore,  each with different gameplay mechanics and cute slice-of-life diary entries for you to discover. You’ll also find an easy-to-use but powerful custom level editor, enabling you to create levels to share with fellow Dream Builders.

To find new custom levels to play and share your own, and discuss the game with your fellow Dream Builders, join us in the Sweet Dreams Alex [url=https://discord.gg/c5vMxrHABR]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Release Date Announced, Demo Available Now!
notes.notes:
A brand new demo of Sweet Dreams Alex is now available ahead of the game’s 5th October release.

The demo contains a variety of hand-crafted puzzles from different dreamscapes based on Alex’s childhood memories, each with their own charming pixel-art-aesthetics, lo-fi soundtrack and unique game mechanics.

[previewyoutube=ScZXbFfYNoo;full][/previewyoutube]

The full game contains over 250 levels across six worlds, each tasking you with constructing winding labyrinths full of distractions to keep Alex’s Nightmares from reaching her until the morning comes. You’ll also be able to design and easily share your very own levels, allowing you to express your creativity and challenge your fellow Dream Builders to solve your creations.

Sweet Dreams Alex will be released on Thursday 5th October 2023, priced at £12.79, $14.99 and €14.79. You can wishlist the game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1561090/Sweet_Dreams_Alex/]here[/url].

Join our community on [url=https://discord.gg/cYQd4Z9b]Discord [/url]to share your thoughts and meet your fellow Dream Builders!

notes.title: Patch - Dec 4

ART: added art for playground structures, except balloons

notes.title: Patch - Nov 27
notes.notes: GAMEPLAY: walls, trees, rocks, bushes and buildings now block the line of sight of the lunchboxes

notes.title: Patch - Nov 26
notes.notes:
Happy thanksgiving!
BUGFIX: dreams can no longer move through towers that are placed on the balloons

notes.title: Patch - Nov 23
notes.notes:
GAMEPLAY: dream swap allowed only if backwards movement is allowed
GAMEPLAY: step-a-logs renamed to jump stones
GAMEPLAY: jump stones now have a wind-up tick (currently uses dream move animation)
GAMEPLAY: jump stones paths no longer are prioritized during pathfinding (they count as 2 moves to cover the wind-up)
GAMEPLAY: dreams no longer can swap if no adjacent (affects swapping on the jump stones)
BUGFIX: destroying rotated playground structures now properly returns them to resource pool
GAMEPLAY: added playground structure: Lunchbox:
- lures dreams that see it horizontally or vertically - lured dreams will try to reach lunchbox instead of Alex
- once a dream reaches lunchbox, it eats it for 2s
ART: slide stun now shows how happy the dream is after riding a slide

notes.title: Patch - Nov 20
notes.notes:
GAMEPLAY: added playground structure: Climbing Log:
- 5x1 log that is raising up
- lowest point can be entered/exited from all sides
- highest point can be exited on all sides
- on the log itself, dreams can only move up or down, cannot leave the log
- can be entered at any point from the highest point of an adjacent log

notes.title: Patch - Nov 17
notes.notes:
ART: added world and level selection screen, progression art

GAMEPLAY: added playground structures:
Tower
- allows to move to other towers and playground structures
Stairs
- a one-way entry to the playground structure
- slows the dream down when on the stairs
Bridge
- connects two towers
- can be built on top of empty space, allowing to bridge the gaps
Slide
- one-way exit point for the playground structures
- stuns the dream on exit for 2s

GAMEPLAY: level structures are now sorted by world in the editor and level selection screen
GAMEPLAY: R hotkey is now used to rotate structures
GAMEPLAY: fast dreams will now swap with slow dreams in front of them
